props.gloss_en: the mishna: paper -- [one is liable for] enough to write a tax receipt on it
a tanna taught: how much is a tax receipt? two letters of a tax receipt
a baraita: one who carries out blank paper -- if it has room to write two letters, he is liable; if not, exempt
Rav Sheshet: what are 'two letters'? two letters of a tax receipt
Rava: two letters of ours and a place to hold it, which is [the size of] a tax receipt
a baraita: one who carries out erased paper or a repaid note -- if its blank part has room to write two letters, he is liable; if not, exempt
the same baraita: or if the whole of it is enough to wrap around the mouth of a small flask of perfume, he is liable
the first tanna: one who carries out a tax receipt before he showed it to the tax collector is liable
the first tanna: once he showed it to the tax collector, he is exempt
R' Yehuda: even once he showed it to the tax collector he is liable
R' Yehuda: because he needs it
Abaye: [the difference] between them is tax runners
Rava: a great tax collector and a small tax collector is [the difference] between them
Rav Ashi: [even] one tax collector is [the difference] between them
Rav Ashi: [R' Yehuda's 'because he needs it' is] because he needs it to show to a second tax collector, as he says to him: see, I am a man of the tax collector

challenges.gloss_en: מיתיבי: erased paper or a repaid note -- if its blank part has room for two letters, liable (= p_neyar_machuk_lovan). בשלמא לרב ששת שפיר; אלא לרבא, הכא בית אחיזה לא צריך -- here no place to hold it is needed! קשיא

objections.gloss_en: ורמינהו: המוציא נייר חלק, אם יש בו כדי לכתוב שתי אותיות חייב -- the blank-paper baraita gives two [plain] letters, against 'two letters of a tax receipt'

answered_by.gloss_en: מאי שתי אותיות? שתי אותיות של קשר מוכסין -- the blank-paper baraita's two letters are a tax receipt's (= p_rs_otiyot_kesher)
שתי אותיות דידן ובית אחיזה, דהיינו קשר מוכסין -- two of our letters plus a place to hold it, which together are a tax receipt (= p_rava_otiyot_didan)
